text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the break, Seiun Sky came wandering
unsteadily into school.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoops, hello there, Trainer. It's Sei-chan, completely out of batteries~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I get time off, I end up wanting to do
all sorts of things instead...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I was reading a famous book on military strategy yesterday too, and it was pretty interesting~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, as for the contents...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, my head's not working at all~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky seemed even sleepier than usual that day.
